proves.claim: pullboard expedite records one expedite event with its reason for the coordinator, is refused COORDINATOR_ONLY for any other caller and USAGE without a reason, and is listed in coordinator help.

cli.expedite.records-reason-coordinator-.why: Without it an expedite could be recorded by a seat or without a stated reason.

proves.claim: pullboard expedite is refused naming jobs.expediteMax once that many items are expedited, and an item whose gate settled no longer counts.

cli.expedite.cap-counts-only-in-flight.why: Without it the coordinator could expedite every item and an expedite would never clear.
